description: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent

summary.one_liner: OmniParser is a Microsoft screen-parsing tool that turns UI screenshots into structured, interactable elements so vision-only GUI agents such as GPT-4V can ground their actions.
keywords: let an llm control my computer by vision
trajectory logging for agent training data
use_cases: Parsing UI screenshots into labeled elements for a vision LLM
Detecting interactable buttons and icons in desktop or app screenshots
Building a pure vision GUI agent that clicks by grounded region
Controlling a Windows 11 VM with an LLM via OmniTool
Collecting agent trajectories as training data
Running a local Gradio demo for screen parsing
how_to_run: huggingface-cli download microsoft/OmniParser-v2.0 icon_detect_v3/model.pt --revision refs/pr/37 --local-dir weights
notable: Converts screenshots into structured elements that a vision LLM can act on
Interactive region detector (YOLOv9-E icon_detect_v3) and icon functional-description caption models
OmniTool controls a Windows 11 VM and supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen 2.5VL and Anthropic Computer Use models
V1.5 adds small-icon detection and per-element interactability prediction
Local trajectory logging for building agent training data
caveats: Icon detection weight is currently only available via a Hugging Face pull request (PR #37) until it is merged, requiring a manual download
Earlier Ultralytics-based icon detectors remain under AGPL license
Caption model weights must be downloaded and renamed manually before use
Trajectory logging documentation is marked as work in progress
